newsitem.title: USA: Champion names Caliendo chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Champion names Caliendo chairman, CEO.

text.p: Champion Financial Corp on Wednesday said it named Paul Caliendo to the post of chairman, president and chief executive officer, replacing Marcy Engelbrecht, who has stepped down and will remain as a non-executive board member.
In a statement, the company said Stephen Carder has also been appointed chief financial officer.

Separately, Champion said it completed its acquisition of National Health Benefits and Casualty Wednesday for $11 million in stock and cash and completed the acquisition of Three Rivers Provider Network for $600,000 in stock
Caliendo, 49, has been principally employed as the president and chief executive of National Health Benefits since 1987.
Stephen Carder, 41, has been principally employed as the executive vice president and chief financial officer of National since 1994.
